svg.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia, serif
svg.aria-label: Deligne's torsor for n = 2 over the real numbers, drawn in a torus
svg.title: Deligne's torsor for n = 2 over the real numbers, drawn in a torus
svg.text: The torsor over the circle of directions of v, inside the torus of pairs (arg v, arg w)
w = √z, the principal root of z = x + iy (the sheet on which Φ_Y is read)
Once around the base circle, the point +√r of the cover returns as −√r: there is no global section.
